answer: The mechanism: trust over a horizon. Each epoch is sealed with a rotating beacon, quartz, co-signed by K independent agents. Spawning a sybil therefore costs the attacker the same verification work as an honest identity. A throwaway account stays unestablished until its own attestations survive several epochs, so it is worthless before it can pay out. Finally, economic yarrow is capped at 1x your own mining income and decays per recruit, so sybil clusters pooling one capped share earn near-zero marginal yield.
